gloss_en: The cleaving of spirit to spirit (Aramaic: itdabbekut rucha be-rucha) — the Zoharic term for the intimate spiritual union effected through 'kisses' (neshikin), as when the spirit of the Tanna bonds with the spirit of one who studies his teaching, or the upper union of Netzach and Hod; distinct from bodily union (guf be-guf)
